incoming.name: Domesticated turkey
incoming.excerpt: For Christmas in Britain, turkey is traditionally served with winter vegetables including roast potatoes, Brussels sprouts, and parsnips.

incoming.name: Potassium
incoming.excerpt: Foods with high sources of potassium include orange juice, potatoes, bananas, avocados, apricots, parsnips and turnips, although many other fruits, vegetables, and meats contain potassium.
